steps.title: Initialize requirements
steps.description: Initialize target directories and check general SDK parameters for Virtual Mouse Touchpad.

steps.title: Configure environment settings
steps.description: Configure compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and Gradle build settings in app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest.xml details
steps.description: Declare system permissions for overlay drawing and bind accessibility service configuration.

steps.title: Define accessibility service xml description
steps.description: Add accessibility_service_config.xml with gesture performance declarations required for virtual mouse clicks.

steps.title: Generate graphical drawable components
steps.description: Generate trackpad buttons, hover bubble circles, and rounded background assets.

steps.title: Build activity_main UI
steps.description: Develop UI layouts containing permission controls, trackpad customization seeks bars, and user instructions.

steps.title: Build floating trackpad UI
steps.description: Design layout_touchpad.xml consisting of sensitive drag areas, left/right clicks, dragging header handles, scroll guides, and minimize options.

steps.title: Build floating bubble widget UI
steps.description: Implement layout_bubble.xml representing the touchpad in minimized condition, which is movable system-wide.

steps.title: Program core launch validation settings
steps.description: Develop MainActivity.java handling user requests for system overlays and accessibility bindings.

steps.title: Develop virtual trackpad core service logic
steps.description: Program MouseService.java tracking finger gestures, shifting virtual pointer, drawing a crisp vector cursor, and triggering system-wide clicks/scrolls.

steps.title: Building Virtual Mouse Touchpad
steps.description: Compile, package, and build the final installable debug APK for Virtual Mouse Touchpad.
